projection_scope: Exact read-only projection of frozen candidate definitions/parameters/invariants/boundaries for calibration. Authoritative source remains the user-supplied isolated bundle candidate_set_sha256.

candidates.name: Canonical Incidence Refinement (CIR)
candidates.native_idea: Iteratively replace each cell-type by the equality type of its current type together with exact incoming and outgoing neighbor-type histograms; read out the stable quotient of cells that remain locally indistinguishable.
candidates.state_carrier: Finite partition P_t of C (or any finite canonical serialization of its blocks). Initial P_0 is equality of a0.
candidates.local_or_update_law: For v∈C, sig_t(v)=( [v]_t, H_out^t(v), H_in^t(v) ), where H_out^t(v)(B)=|{u∈B:(v,u)∈R}| and H_in^t(v)(B)=|{u∈B:(u,v)∈R}|. Define v≡_{t+1}w iff sig_t(v)=sig_t(w).

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.quotient: Q_t=C/≡t; Q_* is the first fixed partition. Class-number serialization is ignored.

scale_refinement_semantics.statement: No scale is inherited or introduced.

invariants: P_{t+1} refines P_t.
There are at most |C|-|P_0| strict refinement steps, hence stabilization is finite.
The update and stable quotient are equivariant under every relabeling isomorphism preserving R and a0.
At a fixed point, one more update changes no block.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: One deterministic refinement operator F is recursively applied: P_t=F^t(P_0). Once F(P)=P, all later iterates equal P.

finite_information_cost.state_bits: A partition can be serialized in O(|C| log|C|) bits; a sparse relation costs O(|R| log|C|) bits.
finite_information_cost.working_counts: Each local histogram entry is an integer in [0,|C|].

arbitrary: serialization/order of class IDs only, explicitly quotient-irrelevant

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: If all cells start with one label on a vertex-transitive regular contact pattern, the refinement may remain one block forever.
Distinct non-isomorphic finite relations can have the same stable quotient statistics; CIR is not a complete isomorphism invariant.

candidates.name: Branch Multiplicity Cascade (BMC)
candidates.native_idea: Propagate exact nonnegative integer multiplicity along declared directed contacts. Branching copies counts, and recoalescence adds them; the integer at a cell is the exact walk multiplicity from the initially occupied set.
candidates.state_carrier: At finite t, m_t:C→N. For a fixed finite input and finite t every value is finite.
candidates.local_or_update_law: m_0(v)=x0(v). For t≥0, m_{t+1}(v)=Σ_{u:(u,v)∈R} m_t(u), with the empty sum equal to 0.

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.support: S_t={v:m_t(v)>0}; support recoalesces all positive multiplicities to one bit.
collapse_quotient_support_semantics.quotient: Optional histogram h_t(k)=|{v:m_t(v)=k}| is a readout only; it is not fed back into the law.

scale_refinement_semantics.statement: No geometric scale. Iteration depth t is recursion depth, not declared spatial scale.

invariants: m_t(v) equals the number of directed length-t walks that start at an initially occupied cell and end at v.
With linear operator L_R defined by (Lm)(v)=Σ_{u→v}m(u), m_{s+t}=L_R^s(m_t)=L_R^{s+t}(m_0).
|S_{t+1}| support is exactly the Boolean-OR predecessor update: v∈S_{t+1} iff some u∈S_t has u→v.
If every cell has the same outdegree d, total multiplicity M_t=Σ_v m_t(v) satisfies M_t=d^t M_0.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: BMC is a semigroup iteration of L_R. Running t steps then s steps is exactly running t+s steps.

finite_information_cost.state_bits: At time t, each count is at most |C|^t for a simple directed relation, so O(|C|·t·log(max(2,|C|))) bits suffice for the count vector; exact values can be much smaller.

structural: declared direction and outdegree pattern of R
arbitrary: choice of when to stop/read t; t is not an intrinsic constant

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: On an acyclic directed relation, all counts become zero after t exceeds the longest directed path length.

In high-branching cyclic relations, multiplicity can grow exponentially while the support has already saturated, so magnitude can mostly report branching combinatorics rather than new support structure.
Two very different predecessor patterns can yield the same multiplicity histogram.

candidates.name: Reversible Parity Echo (RPE)
candidates.native_idea: Use two consecutive parity slices as finite memory. The next slice is the XOR of the older slice with the parity of current neighboring activity, yielding a local second-order law that is exactly reversible.
candidates.local_or_update_law: Let (Aq)(v)=⊕_{u:(u,v)∈R}q(u). Update T(p,q)=(q, p⊕Aq). The occupancy-seeded run starts at (0,x0).

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.quotient: Optional orbit under repeated T is a readout; no collapse is used in the update.

invariants: T is bijective with T^{-1}(q,r)=(r⊕Aq,q).
For symmetric R, the bilinear form ω((p,q),(p',q'))=p·q'⊕q·p' is preserved by T.
Every trajectory is purely periodic from its initial state, with period at most 2^(2|C|).
The mechanism needs no trajectory history beyond the two current slices.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: T^k composes exactly and remains invertible. Forward and backward evolution use the same local adjacency-parity operator.

finite_information_cost.state_bits: Exactly 2|C| bits, excluding storage of R.
finite_information_cost.working_memory: One additional |C|-bit parity accumulator suffices for a synchronous update; it can be streamed cellwise.

structural: symmetry of R for the stated bilinear invariant
arbitrary: choice of GF(2) as the finite algebraic extension
zero initialization of the older slice for occupancy-seeded runs

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: If R is not symmetric, the stated bilinear invariant can fail; a two-cell one-way contact gives a counterexample.
Some symmetric relations produce very short periods, including fixed or 2-cycles, so reversibility alone does not guarantee rich orbit structure.
Parity cancels even multiplicity and therefore intentionally discards integer branch counts.

candidates.name: Pair-Toggle Component Quotient (PTCQ)
candidates.native_idea: Treat each undirected contact as an allowed local rewrite that flips the two endpoint bits. Collapse all states connected by such rewrites; the exact quotient is component-wise parity.
candidates.local_or_update_law: An elementary update along chosen e={u,v} is τ_e(x)=x⊕χ_u⊕χ_v. A finite operational schedule composes elementary updates.

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.quotient: x~y iff x⊕y∈W. This equals mutual reachability under finite sequences of local edge toggles.
collapse_quotient_support_semantics.readout: For each connected component K of (C,E), π_K(x)=⊕_{v∈K}x(v). The full π vector is a complete quotient invariant.

invariants: All edge toggles commute; final state depends only on which edges are used an odd number of times.
Component parity π_K is invariant under every local edge toggle.
W=ker π; therefore dim(GF(2)^C/W) equals the number of connected components.
Two bit states are rewrite-equivalent iff their component-parity vectors are equal.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: Finite schedules compose by XOR-summing their edge generators. Because generators commute, schedule order is irrelevant.

finite_information_cost.state_bits: |C| bits; quotient readout uses one bit per connected component.
finite_information_cost.schedule_cost: A literal length-L schedule costs O(L log(max(2,|E|))) bits, but its net effect compresses to an |E|-bit parity vector or directly to an |C|-bit state delta.

arbitrary: edge schedule, but quotient statements are schedule-independent

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: All connected graphs have a one-bit quotient regardless of cycles, degree distribution, or other internal contact structure; the quotient is deliberately coarse.
An isolated cell cannot be changed by any local toggle, so its bit survives as its own component parity.
Because schedule order is erased, the mechanism cannot encode temporal ordering without adding extra state.

candidates.name: Nonterminal Support Peeling (NSP)
candidates.native_idea: Repeatedly delete occupied cells that do not have two distinct occupied neighbors. The terminal support is the greatest internally self-supporting subset with a two-neighbor witness at every surviving cell.
candidates.state_carrier: A Boolean occupancy bit per cell, equivalently a subset S_t⊆C.
candidates.local_or_update_law: S_{t+1}={v∈S_t : there exist distinct u,w∈S_t with {u,v}∈E and {w,v}∈E}.

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.collapse: Core_2(S_0)=S_* is the first fixed support. No deleted cell is reintroduced.

scale_refinement_semantics.statement: No geometric scale. Iteration depth is only deletion depth.

invariants: S_{t+1}⊆S_t, and there are at most |S_0| strict deletion rounds.
The terminal support S_* has at least two neighbors inside S_* at every surviving cell.
S_* is the greatest subset T⊆S_0 in which every v∈T has at least two neighbors in T.
Core_2 is idempotent: Core_2(Core_2(S))=Core_2(S).
Any sequential process that repeatedly deletes a currently invalid cell and continues until none exists ends at the same S_*.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: Parallel iteration reaches a fixed collapse. Sequential deletion order is composition-safe at the terminal readout even though intermediate states differ.

finite_information_cost.state_bits: |C| occupancy bits plus local counters up to degree, requiring O(|C| log(max(2,|C|))) transient counting bits in a straightforward implementation.

arbitrary: the arity-two witness in the survival law is a deliberate mechanism choice, fixed rather than tunable

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: Every finite forest collapses completely, so the mechanism discards all tree-shaped occupied structure.
A simple occupied cycle survives unchanged, independent of its length, so the terminal support alone does not encode cycle size.
The fixed witness arity two is not forced by the starting substrate; replacing it by another arity would be a new generation, not a parameter adjustment inside this frozen candidate.

candidates.name: Contact-Subdivision Relay (CSR)
candidates.native_idea: Introduce an explicit positive-integer refinement state s by replacing every directed contact with an s-step relay chain. Boolean activity propagates one contact per microstep; sampling original cells every s microsteps exactly reproduces the unrefined Boolean propagation.
candidates.state_carrier: Boolean occupancy on C_s=C ⊔ {(e,j):e∈R,1≤j<s}. It uses |C|+(s-1)|R| bits.
candidates.local_or_update_law: For e=(u,v), replace e by u→(e,1)→…→(e,s-1)→v (and by u→v when s=1). Each microstep is y_{k+1}(z)=OR_{w:(w,z)∈R_s}y_k(w), empty OR=false. Embed base x by setting original cells to x and all relays to 0.

collapse_quotient_support_semantics.collapse: Projection P_s discards relay cells and reads only original-cell bits. At macro-times k=st the relay cells are phase-misaligned and the original-cell projection is the macro readout.

scale_refinement_semantics.meaning: s is an explicit combinatorial delay/refinement index only; it is not distance, radius, or metric.
scale_refinement_semantics.exact_relation: P_s U_s^{st} E_s = B^t for all t≥0. Stronger one-block form: U_s^s E_s = E_s B.
scale_refinement_semantics.refinement_composition: Subdividing every contact by s and then every resulting contact by r is, after relay renaming and forgetting old relay tags, isomorphic to direct subdivision by sr.

invariants: U_s^s E_s = E_s B for every s≥1.
P_s U_s^{st} E_s = B^t for every t≥0.
Refinement composition satisfies Refine_r(Refine_s(R))≅Refine_{sr}(R) as directed relations after relay renaming.
State cost is exactly |C|+(s-1)|R| Boolean bits.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: Macro evolution composes exactly because each block of s microsteps realizes one base update. Refinement indices compose multiplicatively under repeated subdivision.

finite_information_cost.time_cost: One macrostep costs s microsteps; a direct sparse implementation is O(s|R|) local edge visits per macrostep.

arbitrary: positive integer refinement index s, explicitly operational and non-geometric

internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: At macro sample times this refinement adds no new base observable at all: it is exactly a delay-line realization of the same Boolean propagation.
Boolean OR erases branch multiplicity; CSR cannot distinguish one incoming active path from many.
For R=∅, every nonzero base occupancy disappears after one update; refinement only delays the same disappearance.
